walk.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production 2D sprite atlas for a VERTICAL zombie defense game: enemies move from TOP to BOTTOM of screen.
CRITICAL CAMERA: In EVERY walking pose, the zombie must face STRAIGHT AT THE VIEWER, centered front view, head, nose, sternum, belt buckle and both knees facing camera. BOTH eyes and BOTH shoulders equally visible. Feet advance TOWARDS THE CAMERA. NO three-quarter view, NO side view, NO diagonal travel, NO turned chest or face. Subtle elevated gameplay camera only, as in reference. The reference is the existing character: preserve outfit and body type.
Redesign as unmistakably grotesque frightening undead: ash-gray/green cadaver skin, black sunken sockets with small cloudy pupil-less eyes, wasted cheeks, blackened slack uneven mouth with irregular teeth, mottled dark skin, sinewy fingers. More corpse than angry human. Dark illustrated horror game art. No healthy peach skin, no cute chibi proportions, no exposed organs or dismemberment. Uneven shoulder height and loose crooked wrists may convey undeath but MUST NOT turn the body sideways.
Create one atlas, EXACTLY FOUR columns by FOUR equal rows with WIDE clean gutters. Each full character within its cell.
Row 1: four different consecutive front-facing steps. Col1 IMAGE LEFT foot forward near viewer, opposite hand forward. Col2 both feet passing beneath hips, left foot supporting. Col3 IMAGE RIGHT foot forward near viewer, opposite hand forward. Col4 opposite passing pose, right foot supporting. Clearly alternate leading legs, do not repeat one foot forward in every cell. Torso stays square to the viewer.
Row 2: EXACT repeat of row 1.
Rows 3 and 4: eight consecutive collapse poses continuing SAME character at SAME anatomical pixel scale: upright recoil still front-facing; knees buckle; sinking; tipping onto one side; hand contact; hip landing; settling; finally lying still. Collapse can tilt onto side naturally but no rear views. Keep head, torso, hands and limb sizes constant throughout, don't shrink the body as it falls. Bend legs in final poses enough to fit cells at same anatomical scale.
Background MUST be perfectly flat uniform #FF00FF magenta chroma backing, with all gutters, empty space, and holes between limbs filled magenta. No checkerboard, no gradient, no shadow, no debris, no effects, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Character contains no magenta.
CHARACTER: Adult male athlete. Torn RED and black athletic jacket, black shorts, black knee pads, red sneakers. Feral uneven frontal run with slack hands, emaciated cheeks, clearly dead gray-green face and legs.
